messages:
Raj: Quick follow-up from the RFC thread. I propose splitting 'precision profile' into a stable, signed 'capabilities' artifact + a tiny mutable 'runtime_hint'. Gives us immutability guarantees and fast operator control.

Jules: Can you sketch what each contains?

Raj: Capabilities = what the model+hardware pair certifies: supported lanes (fp8/int8/4bit), expected quality envelope (pass/fail thresholds), and canonical fallback order. Signed + content-addressed. Runtime_hint = ephemeral per-request/operator hint (canary, customer pin, emergency opt-out).

Anika: Customers today use per-layer calibration outputs. How do we avoid breaking them?

Marta: Runtime adapter idea: materialize capabilities -> full per-layer profile at deploy-time. Adapter runs calibration transforms and caches results. That keeps existing runtime code paths intact.

Chris: Telemetry requirement: we need token-level delta signals for each lane so we can detect fp8-specific quality regressions. Shadow sampling + deg_score should be first-class.

Anika: Also need dynamic sampling: when a rollout ramps, bump shadow rate for affected tenants. Ops should be able to toggle per-account sample_rate at runtime.

Sam: Storage note: store capabilities as immutable blobs (sha256 id). Human names can be semver-like but not the canonical id. This prevents accidental edits.

Raj: Example capabilities payload (informal): { profile_name: "fp8-core-2026-01", lanes: ["fp8","int8"], quality_anchor: "<=0.7% perplexity increase", fallback: ["int8","float16"] }

Jules: Who is allowed to set runtime_hint? Customer? ops? SRE?

Raj: Plan: three tiers: customer_hint (opt-in, signed), ops_override (account-scoped emergency flag), and policy_hysteresis (SRE-controlled automatic toggles). Server resolves in policy order and chooses the most conservative allowed option.

Chris: Need to define hysteresis: windows, counters, and thresholds. E.g., if deg_score > X for 5m -> demote to int8 for Y minutes. If latency spikes above SLO, ramp fallback. We'll document exact numbers in runbook.

Marta: Add 'regulated=false/true' per-account. If regulated=true then capabilities must exclude lowbit lanes unless customer explicitly signs an acceptance doc.

Sam: API ergonomics: endpoints accept precision=auto|fp8|int8|force_float16 and quality_budget param for auto. Example: POST /v1/generate { precision: "auto", quality_budget: "0.5%" }

Raj: Ops: we need adapter + compatibility shim changes in runtime, plus a migration test verifying adapter output equals current per-layer profiles within tolerances. Canary plan needed.

Anika: I'll build dashboards: deg_score by lane, prompt-cohort drift, tokenwise SNR, shadow sample coverage. Alert if regression crosses threshold.

Chris: SRE will own canary orchestration. Proposal: 72h shadowing, then 1w progressive ramp (1%, 5%, 25%, 50%, 100%) with auto-rollback triggers based on telemetry.

Marta: QA: add canonical prompt set smoke and hallucination checks per-lane. Run in CI for every adapter change.

Sam: I'll draft the API RFC for ergonomics + examples. Need clear semantics for pinning vs hinting.

Jules: Any objections to content-addressed capabilities + runtime_hint split?

Anika: No objections. Two asks: (1) make it trivial to increase shadowing for a tenant, (2) ship baseline dashboards before canary.

Raj: Agreed. Owners: Raj (adapter + migration scripts), Anika (telemetry + dashboards), SRE/Chris (canary + hysteresis policy), Sam (API ergonomics). I'll open infra PR with adapter prototype by EOD Wednesday.

Marta: +1, will design QA smoke.

deploy-bot: canary window scheduled 1799998950 1:00 UTC - will create canary env and post updates.

Sam: small implementation note: runtime should evaluate policy at two points: admission (routing) and pre-dispatch (final lane selection) to allow last-mile operator overrides.

Raj: Good call. Also add light-weight audit log entries for any ops_override or customer_hint usage. We need traceability.

Anika: I'll include audit log hooks in the dashboard so alerts show which policy flipped.

Jules: OK. Ship checklist?

Raj: 1) Adapter PR + tests, 2) shadow telemetry prototype, 3) canary runbook + SRE signoff, 4) API ergonomics PR. Owners assigned. Meeting sync Friday to track.

Marta: Thanks everyone.

Chris: Sounds good.

Anika: :thumbsup:

Raj: I'll post follow-up PR links here when ready.
